title: Code Coverage: What It Shows and Misses

scenes.say: Does high code coverage mean your code is correct? Let's break it down.

scenes.label: Coverage
scenes.sub: Measures what percent of code runs during tests.
scenes.say: Code coverage measures what percent of your code runs during tests.
You might see a coverage report showing ninety-five percent, but miss an assertion for a payment edge case.
Coverage tells you code ran. Correctness means your tests actually check the right things.

scenes.question: Is high coverage always enough?
scenes.wrong: Yes, it means all code is correct.
scenes.right: No, high coverage doesn’t guarantee meaningful tests or correctness.
scenes.say: Is high coverage always enough? No. High coverage doesn’t guarantee meaningful tests or correctness.
